metadata.title: LeTRON Group – Factories and cities that run themselves, under control
metadata.description: LeTRON helps factories, industrial parks and cities automate one operating scope at a time with management software, edge devices and industrial robots, delivered as a service and accepted on measured results. Based in Uong Bi, Quang Ninh.

faqItems.question: What value does the LeTRON platform bring to a business?
faqItems.answer: Digitised operations with real-time data collection and analysis to optimise cost, raise performance and reduce manual errors.

faqItems.question: How is integration with existing systems handled?
faqItems.answer: The platform integrates with existing infrastructure and software through open APIs. LeTRON's engineering team supports the entire deployment.

faqItems.question: Which sectors suit LeTRON solutions?
faqItems.answer: Manufacturing plants, industrial parks, logistics, energy and urban infrastructure; any sector that needs data-driven operations.

faqItems.question: How long does deployment take?
faqItems.answer: It depends on the scale and complexity of existing systems. A pilot project typically goes live within a few weeks.

faqItems.question: Does LeTRON provide customised solutions?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Alongside standard products, LeTRON advises on and develops solutions tailored to each company's operations.

loop.title: One task. Five steps. One record.
loop.lead: Every task passes through the same five steps. Status, owner and acceptance result are always clear.

stages.name: Assign
stages.body: Define the work, the owner, the scope and the completion criteria.

stages.name: Execute
stages.body: Devices and robots operate within the assigned scope. Anomalies are recorded immediately.

stages.name: Check
stages.body: Actual results are compared with the criteria. Completion is confirmed only with sufficient evidence.

stages.name: Keep evidence
stages.body: Records are linked to the task, configuration and check result, ready for acceptance and audit.

stages.name: Maintain
stages.body: Equipment condition data becomes inspection and remediation plans before failures occur.

loop.stampNote: Illustrative diagram. Integration with existing systems is established during the pilot.
